title: Store Update 1.44.0
body:
# Store Update 1.44.0

Raiders!

Store Update 1.44.0 is now live, bringing the stunning Static Set to the store. No restart is needed to access it.

Gamescom has officially wrapped up, so Raz and I are getting back into our regular routine. Getting to meet so many of you at the booth was truly the highlight for us, thanks to everyone who stopped by!

See you Topside, //Ossen
